BiblicalUsage: Zuar is the father of Nethaneel, the prince of Issachar in the wilderness. In Numbers 1:8, Nethaneel the son of Zuar. The fuller story is told on the Zuar profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Zuar matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
